issues.description: Documentation mentions encoding_rs crate but doesn't explain its role clearly enough for users unfamiliar with Rust ecosystem
issues.current_content: ripgrep supports all encodings from the [WHATWG Encoding Standard](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-encoding-get) via the `encoding_rs` crate. The `encoding_rs` crate provides a complete implementation of the WHATWG Encoding Standard, ensuring reliable encoding detection and transcoding.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a brief explanation that encoding_rs is Rust's standard implementation of WHATWG encoding standard, originally developed for Firefox and trusted as part of the Rust/Mozilla ecosystem
